canonical.question: What transaction-splitting rule and contract-signing authority does the UT Dallas purchasing methods give?
canonical.expected_primary: Splitting one transaction into several or otherwise breaking down a purchase so that each component falls under a particular dollar threshold is specifically prohibited.
canonical.expected_secondary: only the Purchasing department can sign procurement-related contracts and agreements
canonical.tampered_primary: Splitting transactions across thresholds is approved without procurement review.
